articles.description: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

points: Google is expanding AI Search ads globally as core advertising growth slows.
Alphabet reported a 25% year-over-year revenue increase, reaching $127.6 billion in the third quarter.
Google's AI capabilities continue to evolve and strengthen the company's advertising and search engine strategies.
articles.insight: Google's expansion of AI Search ads globally demonstrates the company's commitment to leveraging AI technology to enhance advertising and search engine capabilities. This move could position Google as a market leader in AI-driven advertising, potentially influencing future growth and industry trends.

articles.title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents
articles.description: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.
articles.summary: A hacker has obtained the personal data of over 40,000 Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents, and has made it publicly available online.
points: Personal data of more than 40,000 Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents, stolen by hacker.
The stolen data, including names, social security numbers, and dates of birth, was posted online.
The breach raises significant concerns about data security and privacy within government agencies.
articles.insight: This incident highlights the urgent need for stronger cybersecurity measures and privacy protocols within government organizations to protect sensitive employee information.
